verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The design record remains correct and complete for its stated, non-executable scope. It accurately distinguishes the existing post-write count-shape detection from overwrite prevention, explains why an advisory ref mutex would not exclude the manual issue-body writer that creates the residual race, and bounds the CAS-store alternative as an open recommendation rather than a completed design. Its fallback analysis is fail-closed: permanent claim refs remain outside any deletion protocol, unreadable lock age never authorizes deletion, writer-controlled timestamps are not treated as trustworthy evidence, and explicit holder-run completion is preferred over age as the primary liveness signal. The prior round had no findings and this round introduces no material change or new defect, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
